title: processors/token_transfer: NewEventsProcessor drops the issuer burn when a revocation redeems pool shares and the other asset's amount rounds to 0

target.versions_affected: v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 (the code involved is the same in both; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: In derived mode generateEventsForRevokedTrustlines infers burns from the number of claimable balances created, so when a revocation redeems pool shares, one leg rounds to 0 and the trustor issues the other asset, the burn of the issuer's leg is lost (and with one claimable balance a 0-amount burn core does not emit is added); the package's own VerifyEvents fails on the ledger. The issue states impact low: the input needs a zero leg, and losing a burn needs an issuer trustor; no pubnet instance was searched.

entries.expected: NewEventsProcessor reports the burn stellar-core emits for the issuer's redeemed leg, and VerifyEvents passes in derived mode
entries.observed: No corpus entry holds a revocation with a zero leg. By hand on v0.9.0 on ledger 18 of a local stellar-core 30.0.0 network (protocol 30): the SetTrustLineFlags revocation burns 94870 AAA and creates no claimable balance; NewEventsProcessor emits 0 operation events where NewEventsProcessorForUnifiedEvents emits the burn, and VerifyEvents(derived) is false.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's standalone program (the ledger embedded, sha256 of the raw XDR 8c6b277d664fa38514a459be0148de5bf99a68f676529d9f26cb488fe9d6bef5) on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255: NewEventsProcessor gives 0 operation events, the unified processor gives burn 94870, and VerifyEvents(lcm, passphrase, false) reports 'balance delta mismatch between events and ledger changes'.
evidence.expected_basis: stellar-core's redeemIntoClaimableBalance (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-core/blob/0e49751aa9ddf892302cca02cea7f3f5d97df9f1/src/transactions/TransactionUtils.cpp#L1677-L1695) burns a leg the trustor issues, creates no claimable balance for a leg of 0 and emits the burn event (CAP-38, CAP-67).

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 before filing on 2026-11-19: the derived processor drops the burn and VerifyEvents fails.

queries: stellar/go-stellar-sdk: every issue and pull request since 2026-11-01
stellar/go-stellar-sdk: the branches with commits since 2026-11-01

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/issues/6058; this record restates the public issue.
